headline: Colombian Peso Weakens 0.5% as Stock Index Closes Flat
summary: Colombia's COLCAP stock index closed almost flat while the peso weakened 0.5% to 3,163 per dollar despite gains in crude oil.
why: Colombia is an oil-exporting Latin American economy whose foreign exchange rates influence domestic inflation and corporate debt servicing.

impacts.name: Colombian Peso
impacts.why: Dollar demand pressured the currency lower despite supportive energy commodity prices.

why_moved: Foreign currency demand outweighed supportive crude oil trends, pulling the peso lower against the dollar.
